source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi Mark! I have a mock-up of the full landing page ready for your review. Here are a few notes:
\- Alan Sans is being used for all the headers
\- I've added some light imagery throughout the site
\- I placed a contact form at the bottom of the page - let me know if you'd like to keep or remove this
\- I added a basic footer because I'm not sure what information you'd like to include here - happy to update it as needed

Looking forward to hearing your feedback!
